Name: Chromanite Power (v0.15 Update)
Description:
Advanced power facilities made with the rare Chromanite element. (Requires Chromanite Mod installed as well)

[h2]Requires the Chromanite Material mod:[/h2]
 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748921886 

This is a Stardeus v0.15 compatibility update of the original Chromanite mod. The goal of this release is to preserve the original functionality and gameplay intent while restoring compatibility with current versions of Stardeus.

[h2]Compatibility updates include:[/h2]
• Removal of Chromanite Material mod requirement so that mod will load properly.

If the mod fails to load, be sure you have the mod linked above in order to run this mod. I'm not going through the trouble of linking these mods.

Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2946988185 

Full credit for the original mod belongs to the original author. This upload exists solely to provide continued compatibility with current versions of Stardeus after the original mod became outdated.

If the original author returns and publishes an official update, I will gladly defer to their version.

Game Version: v0.15.x
Mod Version: 2.0.x
